rootCauseAnalysis.staticReadFinding: run-camp01-production.mjs's runProduction() does `return runController(argv, await createProductionDependencies(options));` -- createProductionDependencies() runs and must resolve BEFORE runController()/proof() is ever invoked. camp01-durable-facts.mjs's inspectInitiating() (called from createProductionDependencies) and camp01-git-trust.mjs both perform REAL git subprocess calls, and camp01-git-trust.mjs:78 issues a real network `git fetch --no-tags --no-recurse-submodules <remoteUrl> +HEAD:refs/camp01/fetched-head +refs/heads/main:refs/camp01/fetched-main` against https://github.com/SwiggitySwerve/MekStation.git, with no explicit timeout visible in invokeGit(). This is a plausible, though not conclusively confirmed, explanation for a silent multi-minute hang in a network-restricted agent sandbox: a fetch that never completes (and never errors) would produce exactly the zero-output, zero-child-process-at-check-time, zero-listening-port symptom observed (a short-lived git-remote-https subprocess spawned and later exited/blocked in a way this session's single post-hoc process check did not catch), without ever starting a server or binding a port -- consistent with, not a violation of, the stop condition.
rootCauseAnalysis.isolatedProbeConfirmation: To separate 'does createProductionDependencies hang' from 'does proof()'s own predecessor-gate logic behave as the brief hypothesized', this session wrote a scratch probe (probe-controller.mjs, sha256 ee2d2a0f1936930625a93f27518f806e32b04ae1422eb4a9b0502ad2df914172) that imports the unmodified, checked-out run-camp01-authority-receipt.mjs and calls its exported runController() DIRECTLY with a fake in-memory state store (load always returns null) and dependencies.verifyPreflight/inspectRowRoot stubbed to THROW if ever reached -- entirely bypassing createProductionDependencies and any git/network activity. Given the exact same camp-01h argv used in the real invocation above, this probe's runController() call returned INSTANTLY with: 'CAMP01_CONTROLLER_INVALID: controller state fields drift', WITHOUT ever invoking the verifyPreflight stub. This proves, independent of the hang, that proof()'s own logic order is: buildProvenanceRecord (passed, since the supplied --spec/--product tuples are well-formed and match row.childChange / capSubject / exact-main mergeSha) -> state = store.load(wave) = null (no registered controller state exists for a standalone camp-01h run) -> because camp-01h's capSubject is 'product-pr' (not 'none'), the null-state synthesis shortcut does NOT apply -> assertState(null, 'camp-01h') calls exactKeys(null, [...]) which fails immediately on '!value' -> throws 'controller state fields drift' BEFORE the predecessor-gate dependency (verifyPreflight, which is what would check camp-01g / proof-02-triage / proof-02-required-repairs / camp-01h-required-repairs) is ever called.
rootCauseAnalysis.conclusionVsAdmissionBriefHypothesis: This CONTRADICTS, rather than confirms, the admission brief's SLICE-2 hypothesis that 'any real controller invocation... would fail fast on the FIRST unmet predecessor it checks (most likely camp-01g...), before ever reaching the composition/witness logic'. The isolated probe proves the predecessor chain is NEVER reached at all for a standalone camp-01h proof invocation -- the controller-state precondition (the same structural blocker camp-proof's own evidence file names as finding F1: a PR-owning row's exact-main proof is only reachable as the tail of an uninterrupted register-pr-target -> reviewed-head-proof -> exact-main-proof lifecycle re-read from on-disk state) fires first, exactly as it did for camp-proof. This is a MORE precise structural finding than either this brief or the camp-proof brief stated in isolation: it generalizes finding F1 from camp-proof to EVERY capSubject='product-pr' wave (camp-00 through camp-01h all have capSubject='product-pr' or 'audit-pr'; none is 'none'), meaning a standalone, unregistered proof invocation can NEVER reach the predecessor gate for any of these rows -- register-pr-target must run first, in the same initiating root, before any proof mode is attempted. The real invocation's hang means this exact chain of reasoning was not independently reconfirmed end-to-end through the real dependency-injected path in this session; only the isolated, dependency-injection-bypassed probe confirms it directly and unambiguously for camp-01h.
